comparison.selection_rule: highest validation mean within the common budget; ties prefer latest
limitations: One training seed and differing recovery/RNG behavior do not establish superiority.
The evaluator and game wrappers are shared between implementations.

trial_plan.selection_rule: highest matching validation mean within 2M; latest checkpoint on ties; lock both before tests
trial_plan.scope: one prospective seed-3 pair; no multi-seed conclusion

recovery.reason: Colab runtime ended externally; its exact final counter was not persisted
recovery.comparison_limit: DQN was uninterrupted; Double DQN has a recovery boundary and a new runtime

double-dqn.wall_time_limit: Original process wall time was lost; recovery wall time is measured separately

timing_note: DQN wall time includes validation, persistence, and polling. Original Double DQN wall time was lost; its recovery segment is measured separately. This is not a throughput comparison.
